## Capture-lifecycle patch

- Android dictation now requires **API33+** and actual on-device capability. API31/32 are unsupported, not a recurring recognizer-restart fallback. Capture rechecks availability and creates only `createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer`; no generic/cloud factory, intent-lookup bypass, model download, audio persistence, Bluetooth voice routing, sound playback or volume/stream muting is used.
- `ContinuousAudioSource` opens a PCM pipe and preflights the **exact** recognition intent with bounded `checkRecognitionSupport` before acquiring `AudioRecord`. The intent uses `EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` (a `ParcelFileDescriptor`), explicit mono/PCM16/16000-Hz metadata, and `EXTRA_SEGMENTED_SESSION = EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE`. One `AudioRecord` and one recognizer remain open across silence. Nonblocking PCM reads/writes handle short writes/EAGAIN and allow cancellation even when the engine never reads. Close is serialized with writes to prevent stale-fd reuse.
- `onEndOfSpeech` is a phrase boundary only: no watchdog, cap, mic close or recognizer restart. A tagged pipe-startup status disables Dart pause/listen timers **before any words**, including before the listen acknowledgment. This event describes app configuration, not provider capability proof.
- Explicit Stop closes the pipe (EOF), retaining the listener for final segments/terminal result for at most two seconds. Segments append exactly (including repeated phrases); current partial corrections replace only the current phrase. Final/error/cancel/activity or engine detach closes descriptors and releases capture; invalidation precedes cancel/destroy callbacks. AudioRecord's worker releases it on exit (nonblocking loop, at most a short scheduling delay).
- Support-query error/timeout, AudioRecord failure, premature ordinary final/segmented end, and any pre-Stop recognition error (including no-match/speech-timeout) emit `error_continuous_recognition_unavailable` and release capture. The existing service/ViewModel treats this as a genuine failure, retains visible words, and **does not restart**. A provider which ignores optional extras is never silently downgraded to the old beeping loop.
- Every capture has a distinct listener identity and Dart-issued capture ID. Android adapter rejects untagged/stale/cancelled queued events. Stop-time native errors remain observable; final-after-Stop and bounded fallback are retained. Installed-local locale queries remain bounded and release their probes. Other platform implementations and restart behavior are unchanged.

## Verified Android contract and limits

Reviewed Android 13 AOSP [`RecognizerIntent.java`](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-13.0.0_r1/core/java/android/speech/RecognizerIntent.java), specifically `EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` and `EXTRA_SEGMENTED_SESSION`. For the audio-source selector, the documented session ends when and only when audio is closed. **Both extras are optional provider features**: an unsupported provider may ignore the source and open its own mic. `RecognitionSupport` has no source/segmentation capability bit; successful exact-intent preflight does not prove that the engine honors it. Runtime early terminal/error detection fails closed, but cannot guarantee an unsupported engine never emits an initial tone or briefly opens its own mic. No claim of Samsung compatibility or acoustic silence is made without real-device acceptance.

## Proof

`test/native/speech_to_text/run.sh` compiles the actual Kotlin plugin and PCM source against the cached Android SDK/Gradle/release Flutter embedding, offline (**no APK**), then runs those class files with explicit JVM Android/Flutter/JSON/media/pipe doubles. It covers exact intent metadata, support timeout/cancel/Stop/detach, short PCM writes/EAGAIN, unread pipe cancellation, read/start failure release, listener/generation fences, continuous silence before/after words, repeated phrases, final-after-EOF, bounded finalization, ignored-provider failure without restart, locale and permission completion. This executes production class files, **not Android framework/engine/audio hardware**. Dart channel/service/ViewModel tests use synthetic text/status/error events, not audio.

Independent source review, an exact-source APK build/install, and human Samsung multi-pause/second-tap/background/privacy/mic-release acceptance remain gates. No device, ADB, permission acceptance, audio playback/capture or automatic send was performed in this source lane.
